data.title: Jeddah Hosts Final Rounds of 2026 Saudi Toyota Championship Karting
data.content:
Jeddah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The final rounds of the 2026 Saudi Toyota Championship Karting start today at the Jeddah Corniche Circuit, featuring 80 competitors who qualified across three preliminary stages in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam to determine the top three podium finishers across various categories and crown the season champions.
    The championship reflects Saudi Arabia's ongoing efforts to develop motorsport, nurture national talent within a structured competitive environment, and uphold high safety and organizational standards to expand local participation.
    -- SPA
12:44 Local Time 09:44 GMT
